v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Quis est iste * qui venit de Edom tinctis véstibus de Bosra? iste formósus in stola sua.
text.en: Who is this that * cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this, that is glorious in His apparel?

text.la: Ego * qui loquor iustítiam et propugnátor sum ad salvándum.
text.en: I that speak * in righteousness, mighty to save.

text.la: Vestítus erat * veste aspérsa sánguine, et vocátur nomen eius Verbum Dei.
text.en: He was clothed * with a vesture dipped in blood, and His name is called The Word of God.

text.la: Quare ergo * rubrum est induméntum tuum, et vestiménta tua sicut calcántium in torculári?
text.en: Wherefore art Thou * red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the wine-vat?

text.la: Tórcular * calcávi solus, et de géntibus non est vir mecum.
text.en: I have trodden * the wine-press alone, and of the people there was none with Me.

text.la: Fratres: Christus assístens Póntifex futurórum bonórum, per ámplius et perféctius tabernáculum non manufáctum, id est, non huius creatiónis: neque per sánguinem hircórum aut vitulórum, sed per próprium sánguinem introívit semel in Sancta, ætérna redemptióne invénta.
text.en: Brethren, Christ being come an High Priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by His Own Blood, He entered in once into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

v.la: Redemísti nos, Dómine, in sánguine tuo.
v.en: Being justified by the Blood of Christ.

r.la: Et fecísti nos Deo nostro regnum.
r.en: We shall be saved from wrath through Him.

text.la: Accessístis * ad Sion montem, et civitátem Dei vivéntis, Ierúsalem cæléstem, et Testaménti novi mediatórem Iesum, et sánguinis aspersiónem mélius loquéntem quam Abel.
text.en: Ye are come * unto Mount Sion and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to Jesus the Mediator of the New Covenant, and to the Blood of sprinkling That speaketh better things than that of Abel.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui unigénitum Fílium tuum mundi Redemptórem constituísti, ac eius Sánguine placári voluísti: concéde, quǽsumus, salútis nostræ prétium solémni cultu ita venerári, atque a præséntis vitæ malis eius virtúte deféndi in terris; ut fructu perpétuo lætémur in cælis.
text.en: Almighty, eternal God, Who made thy only-begotten Son the Redeemer of the world, and willed to be reconciled by His Blood, grant us, we beseech thee, so to worship in this sacred rite the price of our salvation, and to be so protected by its power against the evils of the present life on earth, that we may enjoy its everlasting fruit in heaven.
